en: A sepia-toned photograph of a grand church interior, featuring a central altar with elaborate steps leading up to a raised baldachin (canopy) structure. The church is richly decorated, with ornate columns, arches, chandeliers, and painted ceilings and walls. The architecture is Romanesque Revival or Neo-Romanesque, indicated by the rounded arches and heavy stonework. The photo is bordered, typical of vintage postcards, and there is a logo or insignia in the lower left corner.
